Q6111.reason: Dumping trash can be symbolic speech, but a general littering ordinance is a content-neutral O'Brien regulation of conduct that serves park cleanliness and only incidentally burdens expression.

Q5735.reason: Only a defendant may remove under 28 U.S.C. 1441; the plaintiff's removal was unauthorized, so the defendant's timely remand motion requires return of the entire case.

Q5651.reason: Advertising the car as a 1964 creates an express warranty of description that an 'as is' clause cannot disclaim under UCC 2-316, and express warranty liability does not require seller negligence.
